name: Solar Parade Float
source: Starfinder Society Scenario #1-10: Rites of Rekindling

offensiveAbilities.name: T-Shirt Barrage
offensiveAbilities.description: The solar parade float shoots t-shirts at all enemies within 30 feet. Creatures in the area can attempt a DC 17 Reflex Saving Throw save. On a failure, the t-shirts wrap around their appendages, imposing a –10 foot circumstance penalty to all their Speeds until the end of their next turn. A creature can end this effect early as a single action with the manipulate trait.

offensiveAbilities.name: Trample
offensiveAbilities.description:
Large or smaller, wheels, Basic DC 17 Reflex Saving Throw. After using Trample, the solar parade float can't use Trample again for 2 rounds.

See rules...

The monster Strides up to double its Speed and can move through the spaces of creatures of the listed size, Trampling each creature whose space it enters. The monster can attempt to Trample the same creature only once in a single use of Trample. The monster deals the damage of the listed Strike, but trampled creatures can attempt a basic Reflex save at the listed DC (no damage on a critical success, half damage on a success, double damage on a critical failure).
